header: Many pages in one scrolling row
lead: Drag or swipe the row, or tab into it and use the arrow keys. It holds 3 to 20 cards and always takes up one row of height.

items.title: Scroll snap, no script
items.description: The snapping and the momentum come from the browser.

items.title: A named focus stop
items.description: Keyboard users can reach the row and hear what is in it.

items.title: The scrollbar stays
items.description: It shows that there is more to the side.

items.title: The next card is half visible
items.description: This is the second sign that the row goes on.

items.title: One link per card
items.description: The title holds the link, so the whole card is clickable.

items.title: Three to twenty cards
items.description: If all cards should be visible at once, use a Page Card Menu.
